depicts: Cropped fragment of a dark game-tool settings panel: three slider rows with values 130, 315, 290 and labels, above a large empty dark area with two faint orange specks.
text_readable: Readable: "130", "315", "290", "FOV Value", "TurncapX", "TurncapY". The top row is cut by the upper edge, so its label and box are partly clipped.
composition: Sliders are pinned to the top edge and the first row is cut off. Roughly the lower two-thirds is near-empty dark space with two small orange specks. A thin gold border frames left, right and bottom.
tone_and_contrast: Very dark near-black background; gold text and slider outlines are clear against it. The two orange specks are faint. Overall low brightness.
sharpness_and_artifacts: Clean text rendering with no visible blur. Faint noise or banding in the dark area; two small orange specks of unclear origin. Panel border is baked in. No HUD, cursor or watermark visible.
scan_first_read: A dark settings panel with numeric sliders; mostly empty black space. Little sense of what the project is.
